questions.stemHtml: A 59-year-old male complains of visual loss and visual field defects. On the exam, IOP is 20 mm Hg. The exam findings are shown in the images below. Which of these statements is correct about this case?

options.label: A
options.text: Overall CCT in these patients is higher than in POAG

options.label: B
options.text: Patients tend to be younger than those with POAG

options.label: C

options.label: D
options.text: Ocular perfusion pressure may be relatively higher than in POAG.
